public_summary: A legacy execution host missed its heartbeat deadline and latched itself out of execution instead of continuing unsupervised; the account was flat.
historical_context: The latch worked as designed, but no operator alert fired: the stop was found five days later during a read-only review. Alerting on execution latches and stale publication is now a required launch gate for the successor executor. The legacy host was left stopped and is being retired rather than repaired. The cause of the late heartbeat response is not established.

limitations: Protected operational evidence is withheld; this record states only the reviewed governance outcome.
The root cause of the delayed heartbeat response is unproven.

current_authorization_disclaimer: Historical event only; not current authorization.
